label: Dominator sets
subgoals: Initialize every non-entry dominator set to all blocks
Intersect the predecessors' sets and add the block itself

label: Immediate dominators and the tree
subgoals: List the strict dominators of the block
Pick the strict dominator closest to the block as its immediate dominator
Link every block to its immediate dominator to form the tree

label: Dominance frontiers
subgoals: Find the joins: blocks with two or more predecessors
Walk up the dominator tree from each predecessor to the join's immediate dominator
Add the join to the frontier of every block on that walk
